*Curcuma longa*or Turmeric is an Indian spice obtained from the rhizome and roots of the Curcuma longa plant. It has been utilized in traditional medicine and cooking for thousands of years. Many of Turmeric’s beneficial actions are due to the antioxidant and regulatory mechanism exerted by its bioactive components, curcuminoids. Turmeric Essential Oil has powerful anti-allergic, anti-bacterial, anti-microbial, anti-fungal Properties.
